name: Bupropion
description: A norepinephrine and dopamine reuptake inhibitor approved for major depressive disorder, seasonal affective disorder and smoking cessation. Lowers the seizure threshold in a dose-dependent way; carries a boxed warning for suicidality in young people.

systems.note: Catecholamine reuptake inhibition; the labelled indications.
Hepatically metabolised and a documented cause of hepatic injury.
Weight loss is a labelled effect, unusual among antidepressants.

monitors.why: Boxed suicidality warning; the labelled monitoring obligation.
